run_pybind11_includes: run pybind11 module to print compiler include flags for Python and pybind11 headers
run_pybind11_help: run pybind11 module to display usage help and available command-line arguments
build_include_flags: build a shell command with -I flags for all unique Python and pybind11 header directories
test_includes_flag: test the --includes flag of pybind11 CLI to verify correct header paths are printed
review_main_entry: review the pybind11 __main__ entry point and its argparse-based CLI argument handling
